units.Psalms 145:1: Hallelujah. Of Haggai and Zechariah. Praise the Lord, my soul.
units.Psalms 145:2: I will praise the Lord throughout my life; I will make music to my God as long as I exist.
units.Psalms 145:3: Do not trust in rulers and in sons of men who have no salvation.
units.Psalms 145:4: His spirit will go out, and he will return to his earth; on that day all their reasonings will perish.
units.Psalms 145:5: Happy the one whose Helper is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the Lord his God,
units.Psalms 145:6: who made heaven and earth, the sea and all that is in them, who keeps truth for ever,
units.Psalms 145:7: who does justice for those wronged, who gives food to the hungry. The Lord releases those in fetters.
units.Psalms 145:8: The Lord raises up those broken down; the Lord makes the blind wise; the Lord loves the righteous.
units.Psalms 145:9: The Lord guards the newcomers; He will take up the orphan and widow, and He will obliterate the way of sinners.
units.Psalms 145:10: The Lord will reign for ever, your God, Zion, through every generation.
units.Psalms 1:1: Blessed is the man who did not walk in the counsel of the ungodly, and did not stand in the way of sinners, and did not sit in the seat of pestilent men;
units.Psalms 1:2: but his will is in the Lord’s law, and on His law he will meditate day and night.
units.Psalms 1:3: He will be like the tree planted beside the outlets of waters, which will give its fruit in its season, and whose leaf will not fall off; and everything he does will be prospered.
units.Psalms 1:4: Not so the ungodly, not so, but like chaff which the wind flings away from the face of the earth.
units.Psalms 1:5: Therefore the ungodly will not rise in judgment, nor sinners in the council of the righteous;
units.Psalms 1:6: for the Lord knows the way of the righteous, and the way of the ungodly will perish.
units.Proverbs 20:5: Counsel in a man’s heart is deep water, but an intelligent man will draw it out.
units.Psalms 7:9: The Lord will judge peoples. Judge me, Lord, according to my righteousness and according to my innocence upon me.
units.Psalms 7:10: Let sinners’ wickedness come to an end, and Thou wilt direct the righteous one, God who tests hearts and kidneys.
units.Psalms 7:11: Righteous is my help from God, who saves those upright in heart.
units.Psalms 7:12: God is a righteous judge, strong and patient, not bringing wrath every day.
units.Romans 2:1: Therefore you are without excuse, O man—whoever you are who judges. For when you judge another, you condemn yourself, because you who judge practice the same things.
units.Romans 2:2: And we know that God’s judgment against those who practice such things is according to truth.
units.Romans 2:3: But do you think, O man—you who judge those who practice such things and do them yourself—that you will escape God’s judgment?
units.Romans 2:4: Or do you despise the wealth of His kindness and forbearance and patience, not knowing that God’s kindness leads you to repentance?
units.Romans 2:5: But by your hardness and unrepentant heart, you store up wrath for yourself on the day of wrath and revelation of God’s righteous judgment,
units.Romans 2:6: who will repay each according to his works:
units.Romans 2:7: to those who, through perseverance in good work, seek glory and honor and incorruptibility, eternal life;
units.Romans 2:8: but to those acting from selfish ambition, who disobey the truth but obey unrighteousness, wrath and fury,
units.Romans 2:9: affliction and distress upon every human soul that does evil—the Jew first and also the Greek;
units.Romans 2:10: but glory and honor and peace to everyone who does good, to the Jew first and also to the Greek.
units.Romans 2:11: For there is no partiality with God.
units.Proverbs 13:11: Property pursued eagerly with lawlessness becomes less, but one who gathers for himself with piety will increase; a righteous person has compassion and lends.
units.Ezekiel 43:1: He led me to the gate facing east and brought me out.
units.Ezekiel 43:2: Look—the glory of the God of Israel was coming by the way of the gate facing east. The sound of the camp was like the sound of many redoubling their sound, and the earth flashed like radiance from the glory all around.
units.Ezekiel 43:3: The vision I saw was like the vision I had seen when I was entering to anoint the city; and the vision of the chariot I saw was like the vision I had seen by the River Chobar. I fall on my face.
units.Ezekiel 43:4: The glory of the Lord entered the house by the way of the gate facing east.
units.Ezekiel 43:5: A spirit lifted me and brought me into the inner court. Look—the house was full of the glory of the Lord.
units.Ezekiel 43:6: I stood, and look—a voice from the house, speaking to me, while the man stood next to me.
units.Ezekiel 43:7: He said to me, “Have you seen, son of man, the place of My throne and the place of the footprints of My feet, where My name will dwell among the house of Israel for ever? The house of Israel will no longer profane My holy name, neither they nor their rulers, by their prostitution and by the murders of the rulers among them—
units.Ezekiel 43:8: —when they set My vestibule among their vestibules and My doorposts next to their doorposts, and placed My wall as adjoining Me and them. They profaned My holy name by the lawless deeds they practiced, and I wiped them out in My wrath and in slaughter.
units.Ezekiel 43:9: Now let them drive their prostitution and the murders of their rulers away from Me, and I will dwell among them for ever.
units.Jeremiah 2:9: Therefore I will still enter judgment with you, says the Lord, and with your children’s children I will enter judgment.
units.Jeremiah 2:10: Cross over to the islands of Kittim and see; send to Kedar and consider carefully. See whether such things have happened.
units.Jeremiah 2:11: Will nations exchange their gods, though these are not gods? But My people exchanged their glory, from which they will not benefit.
units.Jeremiah 2:12: Heaven was astonished at this and shuddered exceedingly, says the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 2:13: For My people did two evil things: they abandoned Me, a spring of water of life, and dug broken cisterns for themselves that will not be able to hold water.
units.Psalms 6:1: For the end, among hymns, concerning the eighth. A psalm of David.
units.Psalms 6:2: Lord, do not rebuke me in Thy fury, nor discipline me in Thine anger.
units.Psalms 6:3: Have mercy on me, Lord, for I am weak; heal me, Lord, for my bones were troubled,
units.Psalms 6:4: and my soul was greatly troubled. And Thou, Lord—how long?
units.Psalms 6:5: Return, Lord; rescue my soul. Save me for the sake of Thy mercy.
units.Psalms 6:6: For in death there is no one who remembers Thee; and in Hades, who will give Thee thanks?
units.Psalms 6:7: I grew weary with my groaning; every night I will bathe my bed, with my tears I will wet my resting place.
units.Psalms 6:8: My eye was troubled from anger; I grew old among all my enemies.
units.Psalms 6:9: Stand away from me, all who work lawlessness, for the Lord heard the voice of my weeping.
units.Psalms 6:10: The Lord heard my petition; the Lord accepted my prayer.
units.Psalms 6:11: May all my enemies be ashamed and greatly troubled; may they turn back and be greatly put to shame quickly.
units.Isaiah 5:18: Woe to those drawing sins as with a long cord and lawless deeds as with the strap of a heifer’s yoke,
units.Isaiah 5:19: who say, “Let what He will do approach quickly, so that we may see, and let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel come, so that we may know!”
units.Isaiah 5:20: Woe to those calling evil good and good evil, making darkness light and light darkness, making bitter sweet and sweet bitter!
units.Isaiah 5:21: Woe to those who are discerning in their own judgment and knowledgeable in their own view!
units.Psalms 138:1: For the end. A psalm for David. Lord, Thou didst test me and know me.
units.Psalms 138:2: Thou knewest my sitting and my rising; Thou didst understand my reasonings from afar.
units.Psalms 138:3: Thou didst trace my path and my measuring cord, and Thou didst foresee all my ways.
units.Psalms 138:4: For there is no word on my tongue,
units.Psalms 138:5: behold, Lord, Thou knewest all things, the last and the first; Thou didst form me and place Thy hand upon me.
units.Psalms 138:6: Thy knowledge was made wondrous beyond me; it grew strong—I cannot reach it.
units.Psalms 138:7: Where can I go from Thy Spirit, and where can I flee from Thy face?
units.Psalms 138:8: If I ascend to heaven, Thou art there; if I descend into Hades, Thou art present.
units.Psalms 138:9: if I take up my wings at dawn and settle at the sea’s farthest reaches,
units.Psalms 138:10: indeed, even there Thy hand will guide me, and Thy right hand will hold me fast.
units.Psalms 138:11: And I said, “Then darkness will trample me, and night is light in my delight.”
units.Psalms 138:12: For darkness will not be dark from Thee, and night will be lit up like day; as its darkness, so also its light.
units.Psalms 70:1: Of David; of the sons of Jonadab and of those first taken captive. God, in Thee I have hoped; may I never be disgraced.
units.Psalms 70:2: In Thy righteousness rescue me and bring me out; bend Thine ear toward me and save me.
units.Psalms 70:3: Become for me a defending God and a fortified place to save me, for Thou art my firm support and my refuge.
units.Psalms 70:4: My God, rescue me from a sinner’s hand, from the hand of one acting lawlessly and unjustly.
units.Psalms 70:5: For Thou art my endurance, Lord; the Lord is my hope from my youth.
units.Psalms 70:6: Upon Thee I was supported from the womb; from my mother’s belly Thou art the One who shelters me. My hymn is continually in Thee.
units.Psalms 70:7: I became like a portent to the many, and Thou art a mighty helper.
units.Psalms 70:8: Let my mouth be filled with praise, so that I may sing of Thy glory, Thy majesty all day.
units.Psalms 70:9: Do not cast me away at the time of old age; when my strength fails, do not forsake me.
units.Psalms 70:10: For my enemies spoke to me, and those watching my soul plotted together,
units.Psalms 70:11: saying, “God has forsaken him! Pursue him and overtake him, for there is no rescuer!”
units.Psalms 70:12: God, do not go far from me; my God, attend to my help!
units.Psalms 70:13: Let those slandering my soul be ashamed and fail; let those seeking evil for me wrap themselves in shame and confusion.
units.Psalms 34:1: Of David. Judge, Lord, those who wrong me; make war on those who make war on me.
units.Psalms 34:2: Take hold of weapon and shield, and rise to my aid.
units.Psalms 34:3: Draw the sword and close the way against those pursuing me; say to my soul, “I am your salvation.”
units.Psalms 34:4: Let those who seek my soul be ashamed and abashed; let those devising evils for me turn backward and be put to shame.
units.Psalms 34:5: Let them become like dust before the wind, with an angel of the Lord pressing them out.
units.Psalms 34:6: Let their way become darkness and a slippery path, with an angel of the Lord pursuing them.
units.Psalms 34:7: For without cause they hid for me the destruction of their trap; without purpose they reproached my soul.
units.Psalms 34:8: Let a trap they do not know come upon them; let the snare they hid catch them, and into that trap they will fall.
units.Psalms 34:9: But my soul will exult in the Lord; it will delight in His salvation.
units.Psalms 34:10: All my bones will say, “Lord, who is like Thee, rescuing the poor from the hand of those stronger than he is, and the poor and needy from those plundering him?”
units.Psalms 34:11: Unjust witnesses rose up; they questioned me about what I did not know.
units.Psalms 34:12: They repaid me evils for good things, and childlessness to my soul.
units.Psalms 34:13: But when they troubled me, I put on sackcloth and humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer will return to my bosom.
units.Psalms 34:14: As for a neighbor, as for our brother, so I sought to please; like one mourning and downcast, so I humbled myself.
units.Nehemiah 13:15: In those days I saw people in Jouda treading winepresses on the Sabbath, bringing sheaves and loading them on donkeys, with wine, grapes, figs and every kind of burden, bringing them to Jerusalem on the Sabbath day. I warned them on the day of their selling.
units.Nehemiah 13:16: People lived there bringing fish and every kind of merchandise, selling on the Sabbath to the sons of Jouda and in Jerusalem.
units.Nehemiah 13:17: I contended with the free men of Jouda and said to them, “What is this evil thing you are doing, profaning the Sabbath day?
units.Nehemiah 13:18: “Did not your fathers do this, so that our God brought all these evils upon them and upon us and upon this city? Yet you add wrath against Israel by profaning the Sabbath.”
units.Nehemiah 13:19: When the gates of Jerusalem were at rest before the Sabbath, I gave orders and they closed the gates. I ordered that they should not be opened until after the Sabbath. I stationed some of my young servants at the gates so that no burdens would be carried on the Sabbath day.
units.Nehemiah 13:20: They all lodged and conducted sales outside Jerusalem once or twice.
units.Nehemiah 13:21: I testified against them and said, “Why are you lodging opposite the wall? If you do it a second time, I will stretch out my hand against you.” From that time they did not come on the Sabbath.
units.Nehemiah 13:22: I told the Levites who were purifying themselves and coming to guard the gates to sanctify the Sabbath day. In these things remember me, O God, and spare me according to the abundance of Thy mercy.
units.Exodus 20:1: The Lord spoke all these words, saying,
units.Exodus 20:2: “I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
units.Exodus 20:3: You shall have no other gods except Me.
units.Exodus 20:4: You shall not make for yourself an idol, nor any likeness of things in heaven above, or in the earth beneath, or in the waters under the earth.
units.Exodus 20:5: You shall not bow down to them, neither shall you serve them; for I am the Lord your God, a jealous God, repaying the sins of fathers upon children to the third and fourth generation of those who hate Me,
units.Exodus 20:6: and showing mercy to thousands, to those who love Me and keep My ordinances.
units.Exodus 20:7: You shall not take the name of the Lord your God in vain; for the Lord shall by no means hold him guiltless who takes His name in vain.
units.Exodus 20:8: Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy.
units.Exodus 20:9: For six days you shall labour and do all your works;
units.Exodus 20:10: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the Lord your God. You shall do no work on it: you, and your son, and your daughter, your male slave, and your female slave, your ox, and your beast of burden, and all your livestock, and the resident foreigner who dwells with you.
units.Exodus 20:11: For in six days the Lord made heaven and earth and the sea and everything in them, and rested on the seventh day. Therefore the Lord blessed the seventh day and made it holy.
units.Nehemiah 9:16: “But they and our fathers acted arrogantly, stiffened their necks and did not listen to Thy commandments.
units.Nehemiah 9:17: “They refused to listen and did not remember Thy wonders that Thou hadst done among them. They stiffened their necks and appointed leadership to return to their slavery in Egypt. But Thou art a merciful and compassionate God, longsuffering and abundant in mercy, and Thou didst not abandon them.
units.Isaiah 58:13: If you turn your foot away from the Sabbaths, from doing your wishes on the holy day, and call the Sabbaths delightful, holy to your God, you will not lift your foot for work or speak a word in anger from your mouth,
units.Isaiah 58:14: and you will trust in the Lord. He will bring you up to earth’s good things and feed you your father Jacob’s inheritance, for the Lord’s mouth has spoken these things.’”
units.Isaiah 56:1: Thus says the Lord: “Keep justice; do righteousness. For the coming of My salvation has drawn near, and the revealing of My mercy.
units.Isaiah 56:2: Happy is the man who does these things, the person holding fast to them, keeping the Sabbaths from profanation and guarding his hands from wrongdoing.”
units.Isaiah 56:3: Let no foreigner attached to the Lord say, “Will the Lord then separate me from His people?” And let no eunuch say, “I am a dry tree.”
units.Isaiah 56:4: Thus says the Lord: “To the eunuchs who keep My Sabbaths, choose what I wish, and hold fast to My covenant,
units.Isaiah 56:5: I will give them in My house and wall a renowned place better than sons and daughters; I will give them an everlasting name, and it will not fail.
units.Isaiah 56:6: And the foreigners attached to the Lord, to serve Him and love the Lord’s name, to become His male and female slaves, and all those keeping My Sabbaths from profanation and holding fast to My covenant—
units.Isaiah 56:7: I will bring them into My holy mountain and make them rejoice in My house of prayer. Their whole burnt offerings and sacrifices will be acceptable on My altar, for My house will be called a house of prayer for all nations,”
units.Isaiah 56:8: said the Lord who gathers Israel’s scattered people, “for I will gather a gathering to him.”
units.Sirach 38:29: So also a potter sitting at his work and turning a wheel with his feet, who is continually anxious over his work, and whose whole labor is measured by number.
units.Sirach 38:30: With his arm he will shape clay, and before his feet he will bend his strength. He will give his heart to completing the coating, and his wakefulness to cleaning the kiln.
units.Sirach 38:31: All these trusted in their hands, and each shows skill in his own work.
units.Sirach 38:32: Without them a city will not be settled, and people will neither sojourn nor walk about.
units.Sirach 38:33: Yet they will not be sought for the people’s council or rise high in the assembly; they will not sit on a judge’s chair or consider a covenant of judgment.
units.Sirach 38:34: They will certainly not make instruction and judgment known or be found among proverbs, but they will sustain the fabric of the world, and their petition is in the work of their craft.
units.Romans 9:14: What, then, shall we say? Is there unrighteousness with God? May it never be!
units.Romans 9:15: For He says to Moses, “I will have mercy on whomever I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whomever I have compassion.”
units.Romans 9:16: So then, it depends not on the one who wills, nor on the one who runs, but on God who has mercy.
units.Romans 9:17: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh, “For this very purpose I raised you up, so that I might demonstrate My power in you, and so that My name might be proclaimed in all the earth.”
units.Romans 9:18: So then, He has mercy on whom He wills, and whom He wills He hardens.
units.Romans 9:19: You will then say to me, “Why, then, does He still find fault? For who has resisted His purpose?”
units.Romans 9:20: But who are you, O man, to answer back to God? Will what is formed say to the One who formed it, “Why didst Thou make me this way?”
units.Romans 9:21: Or does the potter not have authority over the clay, from the same lump to make one vessel for honor and another for dishonor?
units.Romans 9:22: But what if God, willing to demonstrate wrath and to make His power known, endured with much patience vessels of wrath fitted for destruction,
units.Romans 9:23: and did so to make known the wealth of His glory upon vessels of mercy, which He prepared beforehand for glory,
units.Romans 9:24: even us whom He also called, not only from Jews but also from Gentiles?
units.Isaiah 64:7: But now, Lord, Thou art our Father, and we are clay, all the work of Thy hands.
units.Jeremiah 1:4: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Jeremiah 1:5: Before I formed you in the belly, I know you; before you came out of the womb, I have consecrated you. I have appointed you a prophet to nations.
units.Jeremiah 1:6: I said, O Master Lord! Behold, I do not know how to speak, because I am young.
units.Jeremiah 1:7: The Lord said to me, Do not say, I am young, because you will go to everyone to whom I send you, and you will speak according to everything I command you.
units.Jeremiah 1:8: Do not fear them, because I am with you to rescue you, says the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 1:9: The Lord stretched out His hand toward me and touched my mouth. The Lord said to me, Behold, I have put My words into your mouth.
units.Jeremiah 1:10: Behold, today I have appointed you over nations and kingdoms, to uproot, demolish, destroy, build and plant.
units.2 Chronicles 36:11: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem.
units.2 Chronicles 36:12: He did what was evil before the Lord his God. He felt no shame before Jeremiah the prophet, and at what came from the Lord’s mouth,
units.2 Chronicles 36:13: in breaking his obligations to King Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear by God. He hardened his neck and strengthened his heart so as not to return to the Lord God of Israel.
units.2 Chronicles 36:14: All the distinguished men of Judah, the priests, and the people of the land multiplied breaches of faith in the nations’ abominations and defiled the Lord’s house in Jerusalem.
units.2 Chronicles 36:15: The Lord, the God of their fathers, sent through prophets, rising early and sending His messengers, because He spared His people and His sanctuary.
units.2 Chronicles 36:16: They kept sneering at His messengers, treating His words as nothing, and mocking His prophets, until the Lord’s anger rose among His people, until there was no healing.
units.2 Chronicles 36:17: He brought against them a king of the Chaldeans, who killed their young men with the sword in the house of his sanctuary and did not spare Zedekiah. They had no mercy on their virgins and carried away their elders. He handed everything into their hands.
units.2 Chronicles 36:18: All the vessels of God’s house, great and small, the treasures, and all the treasures of the king and the magnates—he brought everything into Babylon.
units.2 Chronicles 36:19: He burned the Lord’s house, demolished Jerusalem’s wall, and burned its citadels with fire, consigning every beautiful article to destruction.
units.2 Chronicles 36:20: He deported the survivors to Babylon, and they became slaves to him and his sons until the kingdom of the Medes,
units.2 Chronicles 36:21: to fulfill the Lord’s word through Jeremiah’s mouth, until the land accepted its Sabbaths, to keep Sabbath. All the days of its desolation it kept Sabbath, to complete seventy years.
units.Jonah 3:1: The word of the Lord came to Jonah a second time, saying:
units.Jonah 3:2: “Rise and go to Nineveh, the great city, and proclaim in it according to the former proclamation that I spoke to you.”
units.Jonah 3:3: Jonah rose and went to Nineveh as the Lord had spoken. Now Nineveh was a city great before God, about a three-day journey.
units.Jonah 3:4: And Jonah began to enter the city, about a day’s journey, and he proclaimed and said, “Three more days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown.”
units.Jonah 3:5: The people of Nineveh believed God, proclaimed a fast and put on sackcloth, from their greatest to their least.
units.Jonah 3:6: The word reached the king of Nineveh. He rose from his throne, took his robe off himself, wrapped himself in sackcloth and sat in ashes.
units.Jonah 3:7: It was proclaimed and declared in Nineveh from the king and his nobles: “Let people and livestock, cattle and sheep, taste nothing; let them not graze or drink water.”
units.Jonah 3:8: People and livestock clothed themselves in sackcloth, and they cried earnestly to God. Each turned away from his evil way and from the injustice in their hands, saying:
units.Jonah 3:9: “Who knows whether God will relent and turn from His fierce anger, so that we certainly do not perish?”
units.Jonah 3:10: God saw their deeds, that they had turned from their evil ways. God relented concerning the calamity He had said He would bring upon them, and He did not do it.
units.Ezekiel 33:10: And you, son of man, say to Israel’s house, ‘You spoke this way: Our wanderings and lawless deeds are upon us, and we waste away in them. How shall we live?’
units.Ezekiel 33:11: Say to them, ‘I live, thus says the Lord: I do not desire the impious man’s death, but rather that he turn from his way and live. Turn back completely from your way! Why are you dying, house of Israel?’
units.Ezekiel 33:12: Say to your people’s sons, ‘A righteous man’s righteousness certainly will not rescue him on the day he wanders, and an impious man’s lawlessness certainly will not harm him on the day he turns from it. A righteous man certainly will not be able to be saved.
units.Ezekiel 33:13: When I speak to the righteous man—this one has trusted in his righteousness, yet commits lawlessness—none of his righteous deeds will ever be remembered. In the injustice he committed, in it he will die.
units.Ezekiel 33:14: When I say to the impious man, “You will surely be put to death,” and he turns from his sin and practices judgment and righteousness,
units.Ezekiel 33:15: and returns a pledge, repays what he seized and walks in the ordinances of life without doing wrong, he will surely live and certainly will not die.
units.Ezekiel 33:16: None of the sins he committed will ever be remembered, because he practiced judgment and righteousness; in these he will live.
units.Jeremiah 6:16: Thus says the Lord: Stand upon the roads and see, and ask for the Lord’s eternal paths and see which is the good way, and walk in it, and you will find purification for your souls. And they said, ‘We will not go.’
units.Jeremiah 6:17: I have appointed watchers over you: Hear the trumpet’s sound! And they said, ‘We will not hear.’
units.Jeremiah 6:18: Therefore the nations heard, and those shepherding their flocks.
units.Jeremiah 6:19: Hear, earth! Behold, I am bringing evils upon this people, the fruit of their turning away, because they did not attend to My words and rejected My law.
units.1 Kings 9:1: When Solomon had finished building the Lord’s house, the king’s house, and every undertaking Solomon wished to carry out,
units.1 Kings 9:2: the Lord appeared to Solomon a second time, as He had appeared at Gibeon.
units.1 Kings 9:3: The Lord said to him, “I have heard the voice of your prayer and supplication which you made before Me. I have done for you according to your whole prayer. I have consecrated this house you did build, to put My name there for ever; My eyes shall be there and My heart always.
units.1 Kings 9:4: As for you, if you walk before Me as your father David walked, with holiness of heart and uprightness, doing all I commanded him, and keep My ordinances and commandments,
units.1 Kings 9:5: then I will establish your royal throne over Israel for ever, as I told your father David, saying, ‘A man ruling in Israel shall not be removed from you.’
units.1 Kings 9:6: But if you and your children indeed turn away from Me and do not keep My commandments and ordinances which Moses set before you, and go and serve other gods and bow down to them,
units.1 Kings 9:7: then I will remove Israel from the land I gave them and cast away from My presence this house I consecrated for My name. Israel shall become a disappearance and a subject of talk among all the peoples.
units.1 Kings 9:8: As for this lofty house, everyone passing through it will be astonished and hiss, saying, ‘Why has the Lord done this to this land and this house?’
units.1 Kings 9:9: They will say, ‘Because they abandoned the Lord their God, who brought their fathers out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery, took hold of foreign gods, bowed down to them, and served them; therefore the Lord brought this calamity upon them.’”
units.Ezekiel 5:7: Therefore thus says the Lord: Because your impulse comes from the nations around you, and you have not walked in My laws or performed My ordinances—nor have you even acted according to the ordinances of the nations around you—
units.Ezekiel 5:8: therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, I am against you, and I will execute judgment in your midst before the nations,
units.Ezekiel 5:9: and I will do among you what I have not done and the like of which I will not do again, according to all your abominations.
units.Ezekiel 5:10: Therefore fathers will eat children in your midst, and children will eat fathers. I will execute judgments against you and scatter all your survivors to every wind.
units.Ezekiel 5:11: Therefore, as I live, says the Lord, surely, because you defiled My holy places with all your abominations, I too will reject you. My eye will not spare, and I too will have no mercy.
units.Ezekiel 5:12: A quarter of you will be consumed by death; a quarter of you will perish by famine within you; a quarter of you I will scatter to every wind; and a quarter of you will fall by the sword around you, and I will draw a sword after them.
units.Ezekiel 5:13: My wrath and My anger against them will be completed, and you will know that I, the Lord, have spoken in My jealousy when I complete My anger against them.
units.Ezekiel 5:14: I will make you a wilderness, and your daughters around you, before every passerby;
units.Ezekiel 5:15: you will be mourned and ravaged among the nations around you when I execute judgments against you in the vengeance of My wrath. I, the Lord, have spoken.
units.Ezekiel 5:16: When I send My arrows of famine against them, they will bring exhaustion, and I will break your support of bread.
units.Ezekiel 5:17: I will send famine and harmful wild animals against you, and I will punish you. Death and blood will pass over you, and I will bring a sword upon you all around. I, the Lord, have spoken.’”
units.Psalms 63:1: For the end. A psalm of David.
units.Psalms 63:2: Hear my voice as I petition, God; take my soul out from fear of the enemy.
units.Psalms 63:3: Thou didst shelter me from a conspiracy of evildoers, from a multitude working lawlessness,
units.Psalms 63:4: who sharpened their tongues like a sword and stretched their bow—a bitter deed—
units.Psalms 63:5: to shoot down a blameless one in hidden places; suddenly they will shoot him down and will not fear.
units.Psalms 63:6: They strengthened an evil word for themselves; they discussed concealing traps; they said, “Who will see them?”
units.Psalms 63:7: They searched out lawless deeds; they failed while searching with a search. A human being will approach, and a deep heart,
units.Psalms 63:8: and God will be exalted. Their blows became an infants’ arrow,
units.Psalms 63:9: and their tongues grew powerless against them. All who saw them were troubled,
units.Psalms 63:10: and every human being feared. They announced God’s works and understood His acts.
units.Psalms 63:11: A righteous person will rejoice in the Lord and hope in Him, and all the upright in heart will be praised.
units.Psalms 16:1: A prayer of David. Hear my righteousness, Lord; attend to my petition; give ear to my prayer, not from deceitful lips.
units.Psalms 16:2: May my judgment come forth from Thy presence; let my eyes see upright things.
units.Psalms 16:3: Thou didst test my heart; Thou didst visit by night; Thou didst try me by fire, and no injustice was found in me,
units.Psalms 16:4: so that my mouth might not speak human deeds. Because of the words of Thy lips, I kept hard paths.
units.Psalms 16:5: Set my steps firmly in Thy paths, so that my steps may not be shaken.
units.Psalms 108:1: For the end. Of David. A psalm. God, do not pass over my praise in silence,
units.Psalms 108:2: for a sinner’s mouth and a deceitful person’s mouth were opened against me; they spoke against me with a deceitful tongue,
units.Psalms 108:3: and surrounded me with words of hatred and fought me without cause.
units.Psalms 108:4: Instead of loving me, they were slandering me, but I was praying.
units.Psalms 108:5: They set evils against me in exchange for good things and hatred in exchange for my love.
units.Psalms 108:6: Appoint a sinner over him, and let a slanderer stand at his right hand.
units.Psalms 108:7: When he is judged, may he come out condemned, and let his prayer become sin.
units.Psalms 108:8: Let his days become few, and may another take his oversight.
units.Psalms 108:9: Let his sons become orphans and his wife a widow.
units.Psalms 108:10: Let his sons be shaken and migrate, and let them beg; let them be cast out from their house sites.
units.Psalms 108:11: Let a lender search out everything he possesses; let strangers plunder his toils.
units.Psalms 108:12: Let no helper exist for him, nor anyone compassionate toward his orphans.
units.Psalms 108:13: Let his children be destroyed; in one generation let his name be erased.
units.Psalms 108:14: May his fathers’ lawlessness be remembered before the Lord, and may his mother’s sin not be erased.
units.Psalms 108:15: Let them be before the Lord continually, and may their memorial be destroyed from the earth,
units.Psalms 108:16: because he did not remember to show mercy and pursued a poor and needy person and one pierced in heart, to put him to death.
units.Psalms 108:17: He loved a curse, and it will come to him; he did not desire blessing, and it will be far from him.
units.Psalms 108:18: He clothed himself in a curse like a garment; it entered his innards like water and his bones like oil.
units.Psalms 108:19: Let it become for him like a garment he puts around himself and like a belt he continually fastens.
units.Jeremiah 7:3: Thus says the Lord, Israel’s God: Correct your ways and your practices, and I will settle you in this place.
units.Jeremiah 7:4: Do not put your confidence in yourselves on false words, because they will not benefit you at all when they say, ‘The Lord’s temple, the Lord’s temple it is.’
units.Jeremiah 7:5: For if you truly correct your ways and practices and truly execute judgment between a man and his neighbor,
units.Jeremiah 7:6: and do not oppress a newcomer, orphan, or widow, and do not shed innocent blood in this place, and do not follow foreign gods to your own harm,
units.Jeremiah 7:7: then I will settle you in this place, in the land I gave your fathers, from age to age.
units.Jeremiah 7:8: But if you have trusted false words from which you will receive no benefit,
units.Jeremiah 7:9: and murder and commit adultery and steal and swear unjustly, and you burned incense to Baal and followed foreign gods whom you do not know, to your own harm,
units.Jeremiah 7:10: and you came and stood before Me in the house over which My name has been called and said, ‘We have kept away, so as not to do all these abominations,’
units.Jeremiah 7:11: is My house, over which My name has been called there, a robbers’ cave before you? And behold, I have seen, says the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 7:29: Shear your head and cast it away, and take up a lament on your lips, because the Lord rejected and thrust away the generation doing these things.
units.Jeremiah 7:30: For Judah’s sons did evil before Me, says the Lord; they set their abominations in the house over which My name has been called, to defile it.
units.Jeremiah 7:31: And they built Topheth’s altar, which is in the ravine of the son of Hinnom, to burn up their sons and daughters in fire, which I did not command them and did not conceive in My heart.
units.Jeremiah 7:32: Therefore behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and they will no longer say Topheth’s Altar or Ravine of the Son of Hinnom, but Ravine of the Slain; and they will bury in Topheth because there is no space.
units.Jeremiah 7:33: And this people’s dead will be food for heaven’s birds and the earth’s wild beasts, and there will be no one to drive them off.
units.Jeremiah 7:34: And I will stop the sound of those rejoicing and the sound of those glad, the voice of bridegroom and the voice of bride, from Judah’s cities and Jerusalem’s thoroughfares, because the whole land will become a desolation.
units.Jeremiah 7:23: But this utterance I commanded them, saying: Hear My voice, and I will be your God and you will be My people; and walk in all My ways that I command you, so that it may be well with you.
units.Jeremiah 7:24: And they did not hear Me, and their ear did not attend, but they walked in the thoughts of their evil heart and went backward rather than forward.
units.Jeremiah 7:25: From the day their fathers left Egypt’s land until this day, I sent out to you all My servants the prophets by day and at dawn, and I sent them.
units.Jeremiah 7:26: And they did not hear Me, and their ear did not attend, and they hardened their neck beyond their fathers.
units.Jeremiah 7:27–28: And you will say this word to them: This is the nation that did not hear the Lord’s voice or accept instruction; faithfulness failed from their mouth.
units.Ezekiel 4:1: “And you, son of man, take a brick, set it before your face, and draw upon it a city—Jerusalem;
units.Ezekiel 4:2: lay siege to it, build forward defenses against it, throw up a palisade against it, set camps against it, and arrange missile positions all around.
units.Ezekiel 4:3: Take an iron pan and place it as an iron wall between you and the city. Prepare your face against it; it will be besieged, and you will besiege it. This is a sign for the sons of Israel.
units.1 Samuel 3:10: The Lord came and stood there. He called him as before, and Samuel said, “Speak, for Thy servant hears.”
units.1 Samuel 3:11: The Lord said to Samuel, “Behold, I am carrying out My words in Israel, so that both ears of everyone who hears them will resound.
units.1 Samuel 3:12: On that day I will raise against Eli everything I have spoken concerning his house. I will begin and bring it to completion.
units.1 Samuel 3:13: I have told him that I am taking vengeance on his house for ever for his sons’ wrongdoings, because his sons were reviling God, and even so he did not admonish them.
units.1 Samuel 3:14: I swore concerning Eli’s house: the wrongdoing of Eli’s house shall never be expiated by incense or sacrifices.”
units.2 Kings 21:1: Manasseh was twelve years old when he became king, and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Opsiba.
units.2 Kings 21:2: He did evil in the Lord’s eyes, according to the abominations of the nations whom the Lord removed before the Israelites.
units.2 Kings 21:3: He rebuilt the high places his father Hezekiah had pulled down, erected an altar for Baal, and made groves as Ahab king of Israel had done. He bowed down to all heaven’s host and served them.
units.2 Kings 21:4: He built an altar in the Lord’s house, as He had said, ‘In Jerusalem I shall place My name.’
units.2 Kings 21:5: He built an altar for all heaven’s host in the two courts of the Lord’s house.
units.2 Kings 21:6: He led his sons through fire, practiced divination from sounds, read omens, and appointed a charmer and knowing ones. He did much evil in the Lord’s eyes, provoking Him.
units.2 Kings 21:7: He placed the carved image of the grove in the house of which the Lord said to David and his son Solomon, ‘In this house and in Jerusalem, which I chose from all Israel’s tribes, I shall place My name there for ever.
units.2 Kings 21:8: I shall no longer shake Israel’s foot from the land I gave their fathers, for those who keep everything I commanded according to the whole commandment My servant Moses commanded them.’
units.2 Kings 21:9: But they did not listen. Manasseh led them astray to do evil in the Lord’s eyes beyond the nations whom the Lord obliterated before the Israelites.
units.2 Kings 21:10: The Lord spoke through His servants the prophets:
units.2 Kings 21:11: ‘Because Manasseh king of Judah has done these evil abominations, worse than everything the Amorite before him did, and has also caused Judah to sin through their idols,
units.2 Kings 21:12: not so! Thus says the Lord, Israel’s God: Behold, I am bringing disasters upon Jerusalem and Judah, so that both ears of everyone hearing shall ring.
units.2 Kings 21:13: I shall stretch over Jerusalem Samaria’s measure and the weight of Ahab’s house. I shall wipe Jerusalem as an alabaster jar is wiped, wiped and overturned on its face.
units.2 Kings 21:14: I shall reject the remnant of My inheritance and hand them into their enemies’ hands. They shall become plunder and booty for all their enemies,
units.2 Kings 21:15: because they did evil in My eyes and provoked Me from the day I brought their fathers out of Egypt until this day.’
units.2 Kings 21:16: Manasseh also poured out very much innocent blood, until he filled Jerusalem from end to end, besides his sins by which he caused Judah to do evil in the Lord’s eyes.
units.Deuteronomy 28:49: The Lord shall bring against you a nation from afar, from the end of the earth, as the swooping of an eagle, a nation whose speech you shall not understand,
units.Deuteronomy 28:50: a nation shameless of countenance, which shall not regard the face of the aged, nor have mercy upon the young.
units.Deuteronomy 28:51: And it shall consume the offspring of your cattle and the produce of your land, leaving you neither grain, nor wine, nor oil, nor the herds of your cattle, nor the flocks of your sheep, until it destroys you.
units.Deuteronomy 28:52: And it shall wear you down in all your cities, until your high and fortified walls wherein you trust are cast down throughout all your land; and it shall afflict you in all your cities which the Lord your God has given you.
units.Deuteronomy 28:53: And you shall eat the offspring of your womb, the flesh of your sons and of your daughters whom the Lord your God has given you, in your straitness and in your distress wherewith your enemy shall afflict you.
units.Deuteronomy 28:54: The tender and most delicate man among you shall look grudgingly upon his brother, and the wife of his bosom, and the children who remain unto him,
units.Deuteronomy 28:55: begrudging any of them the flesh of his children which he eats, because nothing is left unto him, in your straitness and in your distress wherewith your enemies shall afflict you in all your cities.
units.Deuteronomy 28:56: And the tender and most delicate woman among you, whose foot has never ventured to tread upon the earth because of her delicacy and tenderness, shall look grudgingly upon the husband of her bosom, and her son, and her daughter,
units.Deuteronomy 28:57: and upon her afterbirth which comes forth from between her thighs, and the child whom she bears; for she shall eat them secretly for want of all things, in your straitness and in your distress wherewith your enemy shall afflict you in all your cities.
units.Lamentations 4:8: Their appearance grew darker than soot; they were unrecognized at the ways out. Their skin clung to their bones; they dried up and became like wood.
units.Lamentations 4:9: Those wounded by the sword were better off than those wounded by famine; they went away pierced through, deprived of the fields’ produce.
units.Lamentations 4:10: The hands of compassionate women boiled their children; they became food for them at the shattering of the daughter of my people.
units.Lamentations 4:11: The Lord completed His fury and poured out His furious anger. He kindled a fire in Zion, and it consumed her foundations.
units.Psalms 2:7: announcing the Lord’s decree: The Lord said to me, ‘You are My son; today I have begotten you.
units.Psalms 2:8: Ask of Me, and I will give you nations as your inheritance, and the ends of the earth as your possession.
units.Psalms 2:9: You will shepherd them with an iron rod; you will crush them like a potter’s vessel.’”
units.Psalms 2:10: And now, kings, understand; be instructed, all who judge the earth.
units.Psalms 2:11: Serve the Lord with fear, and exult in Him with trembling.
units.Psalms 2:12: Take hold of instruction, lest the Lord become angry and you perish from a righteous way. When His fury burns quickly, blessed are all who have trusted in Him.
units.Isaiah 30:8: Now then, sit and write these things on a tablet and in a book, because these things will endure for days of appointed times and for ever.
units.Isaiah 30:9: For this is a disobedient people, lying sons who did not want to hear God’s law,
units.Isaiah 30:10: who say to the prophets, “Do not announce to us,” and to those seeing visions, “Do not speak to us. Instead, speak to us and announce another deception,
units.Isaiah 30:11: and turn us from this way, remove this path from us, and remove Israel’s Holy One from us.”
units.Isaiah 30:12: Therefore thus says the Lord, Israel’s Holy One: “Because you disobeyed these words and hoped in falsehood, and because you grumbled and came to trust in this word,
units.Isaiah 30:13: therefore this sin will be for you like a wall falling immediately in a captured fortified city, whose fall is immediately at hand,
units.Isaiah 30:14: and its fall will be like the shattering of an earthen vessel, fine pieces from a jar, so that no shard is found among them with which to lift fire or draw a little water.”
units.Zephaniah 1:1: The word of the Lord that came to Zephaniah, son of Cushi, son of Gedaliah, son of Amariah, son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah son of Amon, king of Judah.
units.Zephaniah 1:2: Let everything utterly disappear from the face of the earth, says the Lord,
units.Zephaniah 1:3: let humanity and livestock disappear, let birds of the sky and fish of the sea disappear, and I will remove people from the face of the earth, says the Lord.
units.Zephaniah 1:4: I will stretch My hand against Judah and all Jerusalem’s inhabitants, and remove from this place the names of Baal and the names of the priests,
units.Zephaniah 1:5: those worshiping the army of heaven on rooftops, those swearing by the Lord and those swearing by their king,
units.Zephaniah 1:6: those turning away from the Lord, those who did not seek the Lord and those who did not hold fast to the Lord.
units.Acts 16:16: As we were going to the place of prayer, a slave girl with a spirit of divination met us. She brought her masters much profit by fortune-telling.
units.Acts 16:17: She followed Paul and us, crying out, “These men are servants of God Most High, who proclaim to you the way of salvation.”
units.Acts 16:18: She kept doing this for many days. Paul, greatly troubled, turned and said to the spirit, “I command you in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her.” It came out that very hour.
units.Acts 16:19: When her masters saw that their hope of profit had gone out, they seized Paul and Silas and dragged them into the marketplace before the rulers.
units.Acts 16:20: They brought them before the magistrates and said, “These men are throwing our city into turmoil. They are Jews,
units.Acts 16:21: and they proclaim customs that we, being Romans, are not permitted to accept or practice.”
units.Acts 16:22: The crowd joined the attack against them. The magistrates tore off their garments and ordered them to be beaten with rods.
units.Acts 16:23: After inflicting many blows on them, they threw them into prison and ordered the jailer to keep them securely.
units.Acts 16:24: Having received such an order, he put them in the inner prison and secured their feet in the stocks.
units.Acts 16:25: About midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, while the prisoners listened to them.
units.Acts 16:26: Suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the jail’s foundations were shaken. At once all the doors opened, and everyone’s bonds were loosened.
units.Jeremiah 33:1: At the beginning of the reign of King Jehoiakim son of Josiah, this word came from the Lord:
units.Jeremiah 33:2: Thus said the Lord: Stand in the courtyard of the Lord’s house and deliver an oracle to all the Judeans and all who come to bow down in the Lord’s house—all the words I commanded you to deliver to them. Do not take away a word.
units.Jeremiah 33:3: Perhaps they will hear and turn, each from his evil way, and I will cease from the evils I plan to do to them because of their evil practices.
units.Jeremiah 33:4: And say: Thus said the Lord: If you do not hear Me, walking in My ordinances that I set before your face,
units.Jeremiah 33:5: listening to the words of My servants the prophets whom I send to you from early morning, and have sent—though you did not listen to Me—
units.Jeremiah 33:6: then I will make this house like Shiloh and make the city a curse to all the nations of all the earth.
units.Psalms 68:8: for on Thine account I endured reproach; embarrassment covered my face.
units.Psalms 68:9: I became estranged from my brothers and a foreigner to my mother’s sons,
units.Psalms 68:10: for zeal for Thy house devoured me, and the reproaches of those reproaching Thee fell upon me.
units.Psalms 68:11: I bowed my soul down in fasting, and it became a reproach to me.
units.Psalms 68:12: I made sackcloth my garment, and became a proverb to them.
units.Psalms 68:13: Those sitting in the gate talked against me, and wine-drinkers sang about me.
units.Amos 3:1: Hear this word that the Lord spoke against you, house of Israel, and against every tribe I brought up from Egypt’s land, saying:
units.Amos 3:2: “You alone have I known among all the earth’s tribes; therefore I will exact judgment upon you for all your sins.”
units.Amos 3:3: Will two go together at all unless they make themselves known to one another?
units.Amos 3:4: Will a lion roar from its thicket without prey? Will a young lion give its voice from its enclosure at all unless it has seized something?
units.Amos 3:5: Will a bird fall upon the ground without a fowler? Will a trap be sprung upon the ground without catching something?
units.Amos 3:6: Will a trumpet sound in a city and the people not be alarmed? Will there be calamity in a city that the Lord has not done?
units.Amos 3:7: For the Lord God will certainly do no deed unless He reveals His discipline to His servants the prophets.
units.Amos 3:8: A lion will roar—and who will not fear? The Lord God has spoken—and who will not prophesy?
units.Psalms 38:1: For the end. For Jeduthun. A song of David.
units.Psalms 38:2: I said, “I will guard my ways so as not to sin with my tongue.” I placed a guard upon my mouth when the sinner stood against me.
units.Psalms 38:3: I became mute and was humbled and kept silent from good things, and my pain was renewed.
units.Psalms 38:4: My heart grew hot within me, and in my meditation a fire will be kindled. I spoke with my tongue:
units.Psalms 38:5: “Make known to me, Lord, my limit and the number of my days, what it is, so that I may know what I lack.
units.Psalms 30:10: Have mercy on me, Lord, for I am afflicted; my eye was troubled with anger, my soul and my belly too.
units.Psalms 30:11: For my life failed in pain and my years in groaning; my strength grew weak in poverty, and my bones were troubled.
units.Psalms 30:12: Beyond all my enemies I became a reproach, and greatly so to my neighbors, and a fear to my acquaintances; those who watched me outside fled from me.
units.Psalms 30:13: I was forgotten from the heart like a dead person; I became like a lost vessel.
units.Psalms 30:14: For I heard the reproach of many dwelling all around; as they gathered together against me, they planned to take my soul.
units.Psalms 30:15: But I hoped in Thee, Lord; I said, “Thou art my God.”
units.Psalms 30:16: My seasons are in Thy hands; rescue me from the hand of my enemies and from those who pursue me.
units.Psalms 30:17: Make Thy face shine upon Thy servant; save me in Thy mercy.
units.Isaiah 42:10: Sing a new hymn to the Lord—its beginning: “Glorify His name from the earth’s extremity, you who go down to the sea and sail it, islands and their inhabitants.”
units.Isaiah 42:11: Rejoice, wilderness and its villages, settlements and those inhabiting Kedar. Those inhabiting Petra will rejoice and cry out from the mountain tops.
units.Isaiah 42:12: They will give God glory and announce His praiseworthy deeds in the islands.
units.Isaiah 42:13: The Lord God of Powers will go out and crush war. He will rouse zeal and cry out mightily against His enemies.
units.Isaiah 42:14: “I was silent; surely I will not always be silent and hold back? I endured like a woman giving birth; I will astonish and dry up together.
units.Isaiah 42:15: I will turn rivers into islands and dry up marshes.
units.Jeremiah 11:18: Lord, make it known to me, and I will know; then I saw their practices.
units.Jeremiah 11:19: But I, like a guileless lamb led to be slaughtered, did not know. Against me they devised an evil design, saying: Come, let us put wood into his bread and wipe him out from the land of the living, and his name will certainly be remembered no more.
units.Jeremiah 11:20: Lord, who judges justly, who tests kidneys and hearts, may I see the vengeance from Thee upon them, because to Thee I revealed my claim of right.

units.Jeremiah 11:22: Behold, I will visit them; their young men will die by the sword, and their sons and daughters will end their lives in famine,
units.Jeremiah 11:23: and no remnant of them will remain, because I will bring evils upon those dwelling in Anathoth in the year of their visitation.
units.Job 3:1: After this Job opened his mouth and cursed his day,
units.Job 3:3: “May the day perish on which I was born, and the night in which they said, ‘Behold, a male child!’
units.Job 3:4: May that day be darkness; may the Lord above not seek it out, and may no brightness come upon it.
units.Job 3:5: May darkness and death’s shadow take possession of it; may gloom come upon it.
units.Job 3:6: May that day and night be cursed; may darkness carry it away. May it not belong among the days of the year or be numbered among the days of the months.
units.Job 3:7: But may that night be pain, and may neither gladness nor joy come upon it.
units.Job 3:8: But may the one who curses that day curse it, the one who is about to subdue the great sea creature.
units.Job 3:9: May the stars of that night be darkened; may it wait and not come into light, and may it not see the morning star rising,
units.Job 3:10: because it did not close the gates of my mother’s womb; for it would have removed pain from my eyes.
units.Job 3:11: For why did I not die in the womb, come out from the belly and immediately perish?
units.Job 3:12: Why did knees meet me? Why did I suck breasts?
units.Job 3:13: Now I would have lain down and been quiet; I would have slept and rested
units.Job 3:14: with kings, counselors of the earth, who exulted in swords,
units.Job 3:15: or with rulers who had much gold, who filled their houses with silver,
units.Job 3:16: or like a miscarriage coming out of a mother’s womb, or like infants who never saw light.
units.Job 3:17: There the ungodly kindled the fury of anger; there those worn out in body rested.
units.Job 3:18: Together the age-old ones did not hear a tax collector’s voice.
units.Job 3:19: Small and great are there, and the servant does not fear his master.
units.Job 3:20: For why has light been given to those in bitterness, and life to souls in pain,
units.Job 3:21: who long for death and do not obtain it, digging for it as for treasures,
units.Job 3:22: and become overjoyed if they obtain it?
units.Job 3:23: Death is rest for a man, for God has shut him in.

units.Genesis 19:28: And he looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward the land of the surrounding country; and he saw, and behold, a flame rose from the earth as the vapour of a furnace.
units.Genesis 19:29: And when the Lord blotted out all the cities of the surrounding country, God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out from the midst of the overthrow, when the Lord overthrew the cities where Lot lived.
units.Jeremiah 44:1: Zedekiah son of Josiah reigned in place of Jehoiakim; Nebuchadnezzar had made him king over Judah.
units.Jeremiah 44:2: Neither he nor his servants nor the people of the land obeyed the Lord’s words, which He spoke through Jeremiah.
units.Jeremiah 44:3: King Zedekiah sent Jehucal son of Shelemiah and Zephaniah son of Maaseiah the priest to Jeremiah, saying, Please pray for us to the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 44:4: Jeremiah came and passed through the midst of the city; they had not put him in prison.
units.Jeremiah 44:5: Pharaoh’s force came out of Egypt. The Chaldeans heard the report about them and withdrew from Jerusalem.
units.Jeremiah 44:6: The Lord’s word came to Jeremiah:
units.Jeremiah 44:7: Thus said the Lord: Tell Judah’s king, who sent to you to seek Me, Pharaoh’s force, which came out to help you, will return to Egypt’s land.
units.Jeremiah 44:8: The Chaldeans themselves will return, fight this city, seize it, and burn it with fire.
units.Jeremiah 44:9: For thus said the Lord: Do not suppose within yourselves, The Chaldeans will flee and leave us. They certainly will not leave.
units.Jeremiah 44:10: Even if you struck the whole Chaldean force fighting you and some were left pierced through, each in his place, these would rise and burn this city with fire.
units.Isaiah 63:7: I remembered the Lord’s mercy, the Lord’s excellent deeds in everything He repays us. The Lord is a good judge for Israel’s house; He brings upon us according to His mercy and the abundance of His righteousness.
units.Isaiah 63:8: He said, “Are they not My people, children who will surely not reject Me?” And He became their salvation
units.Isaiah 63:9: from every affliction. Neither an envoy nor an angel, but the Lord Himself saved them because He loved and spared them. He Himself redeemed them, took them up, and exalted them throughout all the days of the age.
units.Isaiah 63:10: But they disobeyed and provoked His holy spirit. He turned toward hostility against them and Himself fought them.
units.Isaiah 63:11: The one who brought the sheep’s shepherd up from earth remembered days of old. Where is the one who placed the holy spirit among them,
units.Isaiah 63:12: who led Moses by the right hand, the arm of His glory? He overpowered water before Him to make Himself an everlasting name.
units.Isaiah 63:13: He led them through the abyss like a horse through a wilderness, and they did not grow weary.
units.Isaiah 63:14: Like livestock through a plain, a spirit from the Lord came down and guided them. So Thou didst lead Thy people to make Thyself a glorious name.
units.Ezekiel 14:12: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 14:13: “Son of man, if a land sins against Me by committing a transgression, and I stretch My hand against it, shatter its support of bread, send famine upon it, and remove human and livestock from it,
units.Ezekiel 14:14: even if these three men—Noah, Daniel and Job—were within it, they themselves would be saved by their righteousness, says the Lord.
units.Ezekiel 14:15: Even if I bring evil beasts upon the land and punish it, so that it becomes a devastation and no one passes through because of the beasts,
units.Ezekiel 14:16: and these three men were within it, as I live, says the Lord, neither sons nor daughters would be saved; only they themselves would be saved, and the land would be destroyed.
units.Ezekiel 14:17: Or even if I bring a sword upon that land and say, ‘Let a sword pass through the land,’ and remove human and livestock from it,
units.Ezekiel 14:18: and these three men were within it, as I live, says the Lord, they certainly would not rescue sons or daughters; they alone would be saved.
units.Ezekiel 14:19: Or even if I send death upon that land and pour My wrath upon it in blood, to destroy human and livestock from it,
units.Ezekiel 14:20: and Noah, Daniel and Job were within it, as I live, says the Lord, neither sons nor daughters would be left; they would rescue their own lives by their righteousness.
units.Ezekiel 14:21: Thus says the Lord: Even if I send My four evil retributions—sword, famine, evil beasts and death—against Jerusalem, to destroy human and livestock from her,
units.Ezekiel 14:22: and behold, her rescued survivors are left in her, bringing sons and daughters out of her. Behold, they are coming out to you. You will see their ways and their reflections and feel regret over the evils I brought upon Jerusalem—all the evils I brought upon her,
units.Ezekiel 14:23: and they will comfort you, because you will see their ways and their reflections, and recognize that I have not done in vain all that I did in her, says the Lord.”
units.Jeremiah 36:21: Thus said the Lord concerning Ahab and Zedekiah: Behold, I am giving them into Babylon’s king’s hands, and he will strike them before your eyes.
units.Jeremiah 36:22: And all Judah’s deportees in Babylon will take a curse from them, saying: May the Lord make you as He made Zedekiah and Ahab, whom Babylon’s king fried in fire,
units.Jeremiah 36:23: because of the lawlessness they committed in Israel: they committed adultery with their fellow citizens’ wives and delivered an oracle in My name that I did not command them. I am a witness, says the Lord.
units.Deuteronomy 30:15: Behold, I have set before your face this day life and death, good and evil.
units.Deuteronomy 30:16: If you obey the commandments of the Lord your God which I command you this day, to love the Lord your God, to walk in all His ways, and to keep His ordinances and His judgments, then you shall live and be many; and the Lord your God shall bless you in all the land into which you go to inherit it.
units.Deuteronomy 30:17: And if your heart turns aside, and you will not hearken, and you are led astray to bow down unto other gods and serve them,
units.Deuteronomy 30:18: I declare unto you this day that you shall surely perish, and you shall in no wise be long-lived upon the land which the Lord your God gives you, into which you are crossing the Jordan to inherit it.
units.Deuteronomy 30:19: I call heaven and earth to witness unto you this day: I have set before your face life and death, the blessing and the curse. Choose life, that you and your seed may live,
units.Deuteronomy 30:20: to love the Lord your God, to obey His voice, and to cleave unto Him; for this is your life and the length of your days, that you may dwell upon the land which the Lord sware unto your fathers, Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, to give unto them.
units.Jeremiah 45:1: Shephatiah son of Mattan, Gedaliah son of Pashhur, and Jehucal son of Shelemiah heard the words Jeremiah was speaking to the people:
units.Jeremiah 45:2: Thus said the Lord: Whoever remains in this city will die by sword and famine. Whoever goes out to the Chaldeans will live; his life will be his gain, and he will live.
units.Jeremiah 45:3: For thus said the Lord: This city will certainly be handed over to the force of Babylon’s king, and he will seize it.
units.Jeremiah 45:4: They said to the king, Let that man be killed! By speaking these words to them he weakens the hands of the fighters left in the city and of all the people. This man delivers oracles of evil to this people, not peace.
units.Jeremiah 45:5: The king said, He is in your hands—for the king was unable to oppose them.
units.Jeremiah 45:6: They threw him into the pit of Malchiah the king’s son in the prison court and lowered him into the pit. There was no water in it, only mire, and he was in the mire.
units.Jeremiah 41:1: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord while Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, his whole army, and all the land under his rule were fighting Jerusalem and all Judah’s cities:
units.Jeremiah 41:2: Thus said the Lord: Go to Zedekiah king of Judah and tell him, Thus said the Lord: This city will certainly be handed over to Babylon’s king. He will seize it and burn it with fire.
units.Jeremiah 41:3: You will certainly not be saved from his hand. You will certainly be captured and handed over to him. Your eyes will see his eyes, and his mouth will speak with your mouth. You will enter Babylon.
units.Jeremiah 41:4: But hear the Lord’s word, Zedekiah king of Judah. Thus says the Lord:
units.Jeremiah 41:5: You will die in peace. As they wept for your fathers who reigned before you, they will weep for you and lament you, O lord! For I have spoken the word, said the Lord.
units.Psalms 71:1: For Solomon. God, give Thy judgment to the king, and Thy righteousness to the king’s son,
units.Psalms 71:2: to judge Thy people in righteousness, and Thy poor in justice.
units.Psalms 71:3: Let the mountains take up peace for Thy people, and the hills in righteousness.
units.Psalms 71:4: He will judge the poor of the people, and save the children of the needy, and humble the false accuser,
units.Psalms 71:5: and he will endure alongside the sun, and before the moon, through generations of generations.
units.Psalms 71:6: And he will descend like rain upon a fleece, and like drops dripping upon the earth.
units.Psalms 71:7: Righteousness will arise in his days, and abundant peace until the moon is taken away.
units.Obadiah 1:1: The vision of Obadiah. Thus says the Lord God to Idumea: I heard a report from the Lord, and He sent a dispatch to the nations: “Rise up! Let us rise against her for battle!”
units.Obadiah 1:2: Look, I have made you insignificant among the nations; you are greatly dishonored.
units.Obadiah 1:3: The pride of your heart has lifted you up, you who camp in holes in the rocks, raising his dwelling high and saying in his heart, “Who will bring me down to the ground?”
units.Obadiah 1:4: If you soar like an eagle, and if you place your nest among the stars, from there I will bring you down, says the Lord.
units.Obadiah 1:5: If thieves came in to you, or robbers by night, where would you have been cast away? Would they not have stolen enough for themselves? And if grape gatherers came in to you, would they not have left a gleaning?
units.Isaiah 10:16: And it will not be so; rather, the Lord Sabaoth will send dishonor against your honor, and against your glory a burning fire will burn.
units.Isaiah 10:17: Israel’s light will become fire, and He will sanctify him in burning fire and consume the woodland like grass. On that day,
units.Isaiah 10:18: the mountains, hills and forests will be extinguished, and it will consume from soul to flesh. The one fleeing will be like someone fleeing from a burning flame.
units.Isaiah 10:19: Those left from them will be a number, and a child will write them down.

units.Exodus 22:21: You shall not mistreat any widow or orphan.
units.Exodus 22:22: But if you afflict them, and they cry aloud to Me, I will surely listen to their voice,
units.Exodus 22:23: I will be angry with wrath and kill you with the sword. Your wives will become widows and your children orphans.
units.Exodus 22:24: And if you lend silver to your poor brother beside you, you shall not press him hard, neither shall you lay interest upon him.
units.Ezekiel 17:1: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 17:2: “Son of man, tell a story and speak a parable to the house of Israel,
units.Ezekiel 17:3: and say, ‘Thus says the Lord: The great eagle, with great wings and a broad span, full of talons, which has authority to enter Lebanon, took the cedar’s choice parts;
units.Ezekiel 17:4: he nipped off the tips of its tender growth, carried them to the land of Canaan, and set them in a fortified city.
units.Ezekiel 17:5: He took some of the land’s seed and put it in the plain, a plant beside abundant water; he appointed it to be watched over.
units.Ezekiel 17:6: It sprouted and became a weak vine, small in size so that it might appear. Its branches were upon it and its roots beneath it. It became a vine, produced offshoots and extended its climbing growth.
units.Ezekiel 17:7: There was another great eagle, with great wings and many talons. Behold, this vine was intertwined toward him, its roots toward him; it sent its branches to him to water it together with the clod of its planting.
units.Ezekiel 17:8: It grows fat in a good plain beside abundant water, to produce shoots, bear fruit and become a great vine.
units.Ezekiel 17:9: Therefore say, ‘Thus says the Lord: Will it prosper? Will not the roots of its tender growth and its fruit rot, and all its early shoots dry up? No great arm or numerous people will be needed to pull it from its roots.
units.Ezekiel 17:10: Behold, it grows fat—surely it will not prosper? Will it not dry up completely as soon as the scorching wind touches it? It will dry up together with the clod of its growth.’”
units.Ezekiel 17:11: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 17:12: “Son of man, say now to the embittering house, ‘Do you not understand what these things were?’ Say, ‘When Babylon’s king comes against Jerusalem, he will take her king and her rulers and bring them to himself in Babylon.
units.Ezekiel 17:13: He will take one of the royal seed, make a covenant with him, and bring him under a curse-oath. He will take the land’s leaders,
units.Ezekiel 17:14: so that it may become a weak kingdom, not exalt itself at all, and keep his covenant and establish it.
units.Isaiah 10:33: For behold, the Master, the Lord Sabaoth, throws the glorious ones into confusion with strength; those lofty in insolence will be shattered, and the high brought low,
units.Isaiah 10:34: and the high will fall by a sword, while Lebanon will fall with the high.
units.Deuteronomy 29:22: sulfur and salt, burned over; all its land shall neither be sown nor sprout, neither shall any green thing grow upon it, as at the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboiim, which the Lord overthrew in wrath and anger—
units.Deuteronomy 29:23: and all the nations shall say, Why has the Lord done thus unto this land? What does this great heat of anger mean?
units.Deuteronomy 29:24: And they shall say, Because they forsook the covenant of the Lord, the God of their fathers, which He made with their fathers when He brought them forth out of the land of Egypt;
units.Deuteronomy 29:25: and they went and served other gods, and bowed down unto them, whom they did not know, and whom He had not allotted unto them.
units.Deuteronomy 29:26: And the Lord was kindled in wrath against that land, to bring upon it all the curses which are written in this book of the law.
units.Deuteronomy 29:27: And the Lord removed them from their land in wrath, and anger, and exceeding great indignation, and cast them into another land, as it is now.
units.Deuteronomy 29:28: The hidden things belong unto the Lord our God; but the things revealed belong unto us and unto our children for ever, that we may do all the words of this law.
